This also clears a prior pending fault when a new ordinary operation launches.
- While fault_active and CS low, increment a separate extraction-bit count on each SCK rising edge. On its32nd bit clear fault_active. Set MISO to raw_miso XOR (fault_active && !NORM_CS_N && extraction_count==1). Because count updates after the first rising edge, a host sampling1ns afterward sees exactly the first bit inverted; count2..32 is unmodified.
